kind: visual bug fix (WebKit rendering bug in the original page); no timing measured

builds.g0.0b: fixes/g0-revert/patch.diff at main 45a2d3ee (PR-034 rev 2, best build), HASHES checked by rebuild.sh

config.simulator: fw-sim iPhone 15 Pro Max, iOS 26.5 (23F77), 430x775 at 3x; fw-ipad iPad Pro 13 M5, 1032 wide at 2x

cause.summary: The discovered row's stage picture (img.start-selling-platform-stage-bg, filter blur(16px), opacity .5) is clipped by the stage's box but not by its 5% rounded corner in WebKit, so its blurred edge shows as a grey square outside the curve in all four corners.
cause.reference: WebKit bug 312584 'REGRESSION (303819@main): Child with filter:blur() ignores border radius overflow clipping', fixed in 313267@main (commit b8414eccb3, 2026-05-14); first try 312531@main (34213f695a) reverted

presence.metric: pixels inside the stage box and outside its 5% elliptical curve (by more than 1 css px) whose colour is more than 12 away from the card navy rgb(19,25,34); 1598 such pixels per stage at 430x775 3x

v14.note: card4 at that scroll position is covered by v14's end-of-page waitlist layer, not a corner leak

chrome430.v14: 0 on cards 1-3 (card 4 covered by the end-of-page layer)

fix.onG00b: fixes/platform-corners/on-g00b.diff (g0.0b + the rule, baseline-relative; Try-it B, A = fixes/g0-revert/patch.diff)

g0.0b.note: the 324 interior px at 1 level are in A~A2 too (caret)

simulatorRest3sCard2.note: counts only; the card's typing animation runs in both windows

chrome.layers: equal with and without the rule at every card and width

verdict: Card 2's corners go from 1598 grey pixels to 0 in Safari (Simulator) on v14, g0.0 and g0.0b; nothing inside any card changes (Simulator T0; Chrome within its own repaint noise); no new layer or per-frame work; Chrome corners unchanged, its antialiased curve edge moves by at most 8-13 levels.
